stories.title: Lt Gen N. S. Raja Subramani was appointed India's third Chief of Defence Staff
stories.body: he assumed charge on 31 May 2026, also serving as Secretary, Department of Military Affairs.

stories.title: Royal Challengers Bengaluru won IPL 2026 on 31 May
stories.body: defeating Gujarat Titans by five wickets at Ahmedabad; Rajat Patidar captained the side and Virat Kohli starred with an unbeaten 75.

one_liners: Lt Gen N. S. Raja Subramani was appointed India's third Chief of Defence Staff — he assumed charge on 31 May 2026, also serving as Secretary, Department of Military Affairs.
Royal Challengers Bengaluru won IPL 2026 on 31 May — defeating Gujarat Titans by five wickets at Ahmedabad
